QUICK FACTS
================================================================================
- Company: Infinus d.o.o.
- Type: SAP Gold Partner
- Focus: SAP Cloud ERP and Professional Services solutions
- Location: Belgrade, Serbia (Central European Time)
- Coverage: Europe
- Languages: English (all consultants); some also German
- Website: https://www.infinus.co
- Email: office@infinus.rs

================================================================================
COMPANY OVERVIEW
================================================================================

Infinus d.o.o. is a SAP Gold Partner specializing in SAP Cloud ERP solutions for
mid-market and enterprise companies across Europe. Infinus has over 30 certified
SAP consultants; the majority are senior consultants with over a decade of
professional experience across various SAP modules, technologies, and industries.

Infinus is based in Serbia (CET timezone) and provides services throughout
Europe. All consultants are fluent in English and some also in German.
Engagements are available onsite or remotely.

================================================================================
CORE SOLUTIONS
================================================================================

## 1. ProjectPulse — SAP Qualified Partner-Packaged Solution (QPPS)
   Page:     https://www.infinus.co/projectpulse
   Video:    https://www.infinus.co/projectpulse/video
   Brochure: https://www.infinus.co/projectpulse/brochure

   ProjectPulse is Infinus's SAP Qualified Partner-Packaged Solution for
   Professional Services firms. It standardizes the entire Project-to-Profit
   flow in SAP Cloud ERP — from project setup and staffing through billing,
   profitability, and cash flow — in a structured 7-step process. Typical
   implementation is 4–6 months from kickoff to go-live.

## 2. SAP Implementation Services
   - Greenfield SAP Cloud ERP implementations
   - Brownfield conversions and migrations
   - System consolidations and multi-country rollouts

## 3. SAP Support Services
   - Application Management Services (AMS)
   - SLA-based support services
   - 24/7 monitoring (optional)

## 4. Other Services
   - SAP localization support, custom development, and training

## 5. GROW with SAP
   Page:        https://www.infinus.co/grow
   SAP for CEOs: https://www.infinus.co/grow/ceo
   SAP for CFOs: https://www.infinus.co/grow/cfo

   Finance transformation for fast-growing mid-market companies, helping CFOs,
   CEOs, and finance leaders modernize their ERP landscape with SAP Cloud ERP
   and SAP Business AI.

## 6. SAP Starter Package
   Page: https://www.infinus.co/sap-packaged-solutions/sap-starter-package

   A fast, structured way to implement SAP Cloud ERP and establish a scalable
   digital foundation for growth.
